reproduced: ranked finding 3 is the stale-revision exclusion - that the readings at the node's base (1da6dd193) and at the revision the admit service ran (7bd8bc924) are identical on every line, so the service's stale code did not cause the hold (report section 7.3). Re-running the cited script against a reconstruction of the service revision's reckon package (194 files materialized from git show 7bd8bc924:reckon/*) produced readings identical to the base re-run on every line except the two lines naming the imported checkout (reckon.__file__ and flight.__file__); the report's own two cited logs likewise differ only in their rev/checkout header.
